import json
import math
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from PIL import Image
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

repo = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
evidence = repo / 'docs/results/spectral-loss-allocation-v1.json'
index = read(evidence)
assert len(index['copies']) == 10
for item in index['copies'].values():
    assert ref(item['original']['path']) == item['original']
    assert ref(item['public']['path']) == item['public']
    assert item['original']['sha256'] == item['public']['sha256']
    assert Path(item['original']['path']).read_bytes() == Path(item['public']['path']).read_bytes()
source = read(index['sources']['path'])
assert ref(index['sources']['path']) == index['sources']
assert len(source['frozen_neural_hashes_by_filename']) == 85
for name, digest in source['frozen_neural_hashes_by_filename'].items():
    assert ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/name)['sha256'] == digest
for script in source['sources']:
    assert ref(script['path'])['sha256'] == script['sha256']
    assert Path(script['path']).read_text() == script['text']
summary = read(index['summary']['path'])
assert ref(index['summary']['path']) == index['summary']
assert summary['status'].startswith('pass') and summary['scalar_checks'] == 36500
assert summary['Decimal_reductions'] == 78
groups={(g['domain'],g['ADC_only']):g for g in summary['groups']}
report=(repo/'docs/spectral-loss-allocation.md').read_text()
tables=[]
for key, label in [('legacy_total','Current 2 DN'),('post_total','Post-output 2 DN'),('focused_post_total','Peak-weighted post 2 DN'),('floor16_total','Current 16 DN')]:
    a,n=[groups['all-balanced-domains',adc]['parameter_gradient_squared_norm_sum'][key] for adc in [True,False]]
    tables.append(f'|{label}|{math.sqrt(a):.7f}|{math.sqrt(n):.7f}|{100*a/(a+n):.4f}%|')
for domain in ['mesh','weak','flat','mixed','photo']:
    a,n=groups[domain,True],groups[domain,False]
    line=f'|{domain}|{a["batches"]}/{n["batches"]}|'+ '|'.join(f'{math.sqrt(g["parameter_gradient_squared_norm_sum"][key]):.7f}' for key,g in [('legacy_total',a),('legacy_total',n),('floor16_total',a),('floor16_total',n)])+'|'
    tables.append(line)
fulltrace=read(repo/'docs/results/spectral-loss-training-trace-v1.json')
assert ref(fulltrace['auditor']['path'])['sha256']==fulltrace['auditor']['sha256']
assert Path(fulltrace['auditor']['path']).read_text()==fulltrace['auditor']['text']
for field in ['training','cache','training_audit']:
    assert ref(fulltrace[field]['path'])==fulltrace[field]
for g in fulltrace['groups']:
    if g['arm']=='native-matrix' and g['domain']=='all1000':
        label='ADC-only' if g['ADC_only'] else 'Noisy'
        tables.append(f'|{label}|{g["batches"]}|{g["median_logged_preclip_norm"]:.6f}|{g["mean_logged_preclip_norm"]:.6f}|{g["p90_logged_preclip_norm"]:.6f}|{g["maximum_logged_preclip_norm"]:.6f}|{g["norm_exceeds_one"]}|')
assert len(tables)==11 and all(line in report for line in tables)
roots=[repo/f'.cache/quality-20261103/V149-loss-allocation-v{i}' for i in [1,2]]
for root in roots:
    owner=read(root/'result-v1.json')['owner']
    try:
        p=psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
        assert abs(p.create_time()-owner['created'])>.01 or p.status() in ['zombie','dead']
    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
        pass
excluded={psutil.Process().pid,*[p.pid for p in psutil.Process().parents()]}
live=[]
for p in psutil.process_iter(['pid','cmdline','status']):
    try:
        if p.pid not in excluded and p.info['status'] not in ['zombie','dead'] and any(str(root) in arg or str(root.relative_to(repo))==arg for root in roots for arg in p.info['cmdline'] or []):live.append(p.info)
    except (psutil.NoSuchProcess,psutil.AccessDenied):pass
assert not live,live
assets=repo/'docs/images/spectral-loss-allocation-v1'
image=Image.open(assets/'initial-parameter-allocation.png')
assert image.size==(1680,560)
generator=repo/'.cache/plot-spectral-loss-allocation-v1.py'
save(assets/'manifest-v1.json',{'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'images':[ref(assets/n) for n in ['initial-parameter-allocation.png','initial-parameter-allocation.svg']],'source_data':index['summary'],'generator':dict(ref(generator),text=generator.read_text()),'actual_viewing':'Final PNG viewed at original detail after legend/axis-label cleanup. Two-panel scientific diagnostic, not crop pixels or model quality. SVG is the same standalone Matplotlib figure.','no_new_model_quality_claim':True})
docs=['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/research.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/spectral-loss-allocation.md','diary/2026-11-03-14-43-40-spectral-loss-allocation.md']
links=0
for name in docs:
    p=repo/name
    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):continue
        assert (p.parent/link.split('#')[0]).is_file(),(name,link)
        links+=1
